title: 第108章 亲我第107章 御兽宗宗主
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
她的语速快得像是在扫货架上的东西：“有没有什么能让我的实力压过他的道具？他现在这个境界，我硬打打不过。“
系统几乎是秒回，像是早就准备好了给她的方案。
【有，修为压制逆转符，一次性道具，使用后宿主当前修为将自动调整为高于指定目标一个小境界，持续半个时辰。价格三千积分。正好够用。】
“换。“
江欲没有犹豫，积分划出去的同一瞬间，一张通体墨绿色的符纸已经落在了她的神识空间里。
符纸表面没有灵文也没有纹路，只有一层极淡的像是雾气一样在符纸表面缓缓流动的微光。
她在意识里伸手捏住符纸的边角，触感温凉，然后她用力一攥，符纸在她的神识空间中碎裂开来，化作一片细碎的墨绿色光点，无声无息地融进了她的经脉之中。
那一瞬间她感觉到自己的丹田像是被什么东西从底部顶了一下，经脉中流转的灵力骤然膨胀开来。
她能感觉到自己的气息正在以一种她从未体验过的速度攀升，越过她原本的筑基后期，稳稳地停在了一个更高的台阶上，压过了对面那个人正在缓慢回升的灵力波动整整一个小境界。
她睁开眼，迈步朝宗主的方向走了过去，她的步伐比方才沉了一些，每一步落地时带起的气流都比之前更重。
宗主在她迈出第三步的时候就察觉到了不对劲，他扶着椅背想要站起来，可他的动作在江欲走近的同一瞬间慢了半拍。
面前这个年轻女人身上的灵力波动已经比他方才感知到的厚了将近一倍。
江欲走到他面前的时候，抬手就是一掌。
掌风裹着灵力从她掌心涌出的时候带起一道短促而浑厚的气流，宗主来不及完全站起身，只能抬手去挡。
两股灵力在他手臂和她的掌心之间碰撞的瞬间发出一声沉闷的爆响，他的整个人被那股力道推得往后仰去，脊背撞上了身后的墙壁才勉强稳住。
他的手臂落下之后指尖的抖动比方才更加明显，连他自己都控制不住，他的目光落在面前那张依然没有什么表情的脸上，嘴唇动了一下，像是想要说什么，可江欲的第二掌已经又抬了起来。
掌风停在他面前一掌宽的距离上，灵力还在她掌心吞吐着温润的光芒，没有落下，但那股灵压已经足够让他清楚自己现在的境地。
宗主的嘴唇哆嗦了两下，眼神里全都是惊恐。
“你这人简直就是一个怪物。”
“……灵根的事，容我三日。“

江欲站在他面前，看了他两息，确认他没有再要动手的意思，才慢慢收回了手，往后退了半步。
她转过身的时候，看到谢云开正站在门口的位置看着她。
他方才在那些弟子中放倒了好几个人，此刻身上还带着灰痕和青紫，可他站在那里没有靠着门框也没有弯腰。
这就够了。
宗主扶着墙壁慢慢直起身来，扶正了那把翻倒的椅子重新坐下去。
content_en:
She spoke as fast as she was scanning things on the shelves: "Is there any tool that can make me stronger than him? At his current level, I can't beat him hard."
The system responded almost instantly, as if it had already prepared a plan for her.
[Yes, the Cultivation Suppression Reversal Talisman is a one-time prop. After use, the host's current cultivation level will automatically be adjusted to a small level higher than the designated target, which lasts for half an hour. The price is three thousand points. Just enough. 】
"Change."
Jiang Yu didn't hesitate. At the same moment when the points were drawn out, a piece of dark green talisman paper fell into her consciousness space.
There are no spiritual characters or lines on the surface of the talisman paper, only a very light layer of light that slowly flows like mist on the surface of the talisman paper.
In her consciousness, she reached out and pinched the corner of the talisman paper. It felt warm to the touch, and then she squeezed it hard. The talisman paper shattered in the space of her consciousness and turned into a piece of fine dark green light spots, which silently merged into her meridians.
At that moment, she felt as if something had pushed her Dantian from the bottom, and the spiritual power flowing in her meridians suddenly expanded.
She could feel that her aura was rising at a speed she had never experienced before, surpassing her original late stage of foundation building and stopping steadily at a higher level, overwhelming the slowly rising spiritual energy fluctuations of the person opposite her by a whole small level.
She opened her eyes and walked towards the sect leader. Her steps were heavier than before, and the air flow brought up by each step was heavier than before.
The sect leader noticed something was wrong when she took the third step. He held the back of the chair and tried to stand up, but his movements were slowed down by half a beat at the same moment when Jiang Yu approached.
The spiritual energy fluctuations on the young woman in front of him were nearly twice as thick as what he had just perceived.
When Jiang Yu walked in front of him, he raised his hand and slapped him.
When the palm wind wrapped with spiritual power surged out from her palm, it brought up a short and thick air flow. The sect leader had no time to stand up completely, so he could only raise his hand to block it.
The moment the two spiritual powers collided between his arm and her palm, there was a dull explosion. His whole body was pushed back by the force, and his back hit the wall behind him before he could barely stabilize himself.
After his arm fell down, his fingertips trembled more obviously than before, and even he couldn't control it. His eyes fell on the still expressionless face in front of him, and his lips moved as if he wanted to say something, but Jiang Yu's second palm had already been raised.
The palm wind stopped at a palm-width distance in front of him, and the spiritual power was still spitting out a warm light in her palm without falling, but the spiritual pressure was enough to make him aware of his current situation.
The sect leader's lips trembled twice, and his eyes were full of fear.
"You are nothing short of a monster."
"... Regarding the matter of spiritual roots, please allow me three days."
Jiang Yu stood in front of him, looked at him for a few breaths, and confirmed that he had no intention of taking action again, then slowly withdrew his hand and took half a step back.
When she turned around, she saw Xie Yunkai standing at the door looking at her.
He had just knocked down several of those disciples, and his body was still covered in gray marks and bruises, but he stood there without leaning on the door frame or bending down.
That's enough.
The sect leader slowly straightened up while holding on to the wall, straightened the overturned chair and sat down again.
